expected_signal: counter delta is null if ANY intervening sample is missing or non-monotonic; valid increases remain correct
negative_controls: rise-reset-rise first/last valid-looking net increase must return null
missing intermediate cgroup observation must return null
real monotonic increases preserve numeric delta
invalid JSON row does not impersonate a sample
limitations: Not evidence of GPU OOM cause or phone behavior
